text:
mika_pm: Quick sync — pilot customer wants explicit SLA + a telemetry gating clause before they sign. Need owners and final wording by EOD tomorrow.

zhou_eng: I'll validate telemetry signals we can expose. Which metrics are must-haves? p50/p95/p99 latency, error rate, and a token-rate throttle metric?

kelly_fin: Pricing ask: pilot needs a capped monthly invoice with overage protection. Propose a Pilot tier: fixed monthly + burst pool, prorated on activation. Will draft numbers if we get expected qps/tokens.

rachel_docs: Docs will include an "Pilot expectations" section and a short SLA blurb. Need final legal-approved sentence for customer-facing docs.

omar_sre: From runbook POV, telemetry gating means: if telemetry shows repeated p95 spikes AND queue growth, we reserve right to throttle or migrate. We need clear thresholds. Proposal: p95 > 250ms for 15m AND queue delta > 500 in 5m -> trigger gating.

mika_pm: Good. Owners: Telemetry surface & gates -> zhou_eng + omar_sre, Pricing + pilot invoice -> kelly_fin, Docs + public SLA blurb -> rachel_docs, Legal review -> legal-bot. Deadlines: 48h.

zhou_eng: Data note: we can expose p95 and queue depth per-customer; exposing raw token stream is harder. We'll add a synthetic "burst index" metric: tokens/s normalized by reserved capacity.

kelly_fin: For pilot invoice I'll model three scenarios: low, medium, high usage with a capped overage. Will include sample line items: reserved capacity, burst bucket, activation fee (optional).

rachel_docs: Draft SLA sentence: "For Pilot customers, Redwood will aim to maintain p95 latency <= 200ms for <=1KB requests; telemetry gating may be applied if sustained load beyond reserved capacity is detected." Will add legal caveat placeholder.

legal-bot: Reminder: gating clause must define "sustained load" numerically and include customer notification windows. Legal will review the final draft.

omar_sre: Suggested gating snippet for runbook:
```
- Condition: p95 > 250ms for 15m AND queue delta > 500 in 5m -> Trigger: throttle to reserved capacity; page SE for remediation; notify customer 10m after gating
- Escalation: if throttle persists >30m -> incident commander + consider migration to dedicated pool
```

mika_pm: Thanks. If owners can post PRs or drafts here as they finish, I'll compile into the pilot agreement. Shiproom check-in Fri 09:00 PT if all green. React with :thumbsup: if you can attend.

zhou_eng: :thumbsup:

kelly_fin: :thumbsup:

rachel_docs: :thumbsup:

omar_sre: :thumbsup:

mika_pm: Great — keep updates in-thread only. If legal needs faster turnaround, ping me directly.
